node.statement: Replace the first term using node 1.2 and the second term using node 1.3. The result is (Y^dagger dot Z) dot X+Y^dagger dot V-2*Y^dagger dot V=(Y^dagger dot Z) dot X-Y^dagger dot V. With V=Z dot X this is the asserted identity. Since the datum,n,Z,X,Y were arbitrary subject to e<=e_var, universal generalization proves the root contract.
